bullets.title: Ideal Lifestyle Costing page and sample dreamlining spreadsheets on tim.blog
bullets.note: — This is a page and spreadsheet related to _The 4-Hour Workweek_ and calculating the true cost of your ideal lifestyle. The numbers then determine your Target Monthly Income (TMI) or Target Daily Income (TDI), and results can be surprisingly achievable. The download link broke when I changed my domain name to tim.blog. Sorry it took so long to fix!
